theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Match Your Goals to Investment Timelines
body: Different life goals need different time horizons. Longer goals allow more growth potential.
caption: Education, retirement, home, and wedding expenses each have unique timelines and risk profiles. Understanding your time horizon helps shape your investment approach. #GoalBasedInvesting #LifeGoals #InvestmentStrategy #WealthBuilding #SmartInvesting
